description:
Change the pilgrim extras, private transfers or luggage transfer of
        an ALREADY QUOTED Camino de Santiago package, keeping the same hotels
        night by night: no new availability check, answers in a few seconds.
        Pass the COMPLETE new selection: `extras_ids` (from
        camino_extras_catalog; omit for the default credential + insurance),
        `traslados` (from camino_transfer_options; omit or [] for none) and
        `incluir_mochila`. Returns the same shape as quote_camino_package with
        the new single `total_paquete_eur` and a NEW `oferta_paquete_firmada`
        that replaces the previous one. Use it instead of quote_camino_package
        whenever only extras or transfers change. / Añade o quita extras y
        traslados del paquete ya cotizado sin volver a cotizar los hoteles.
        (es: actualizar_extras_paquete)

TrasladoPaquete.description: Traslado elegido para el paquete (de camino_transfer_options).

destino_poblacion_id.description: ID de la población de destino
destino_poblacion_id.title: Destino Poblacion Id

num_pasajeros.description: Pasajeros; por defecto, todos los viajeros
num_pasajeros.title: Num Pasajeros

origen_poblacion_id.description: ID de la población de recogida
origen_poblacion_id.title: Origen Poblacion Id

TrasladoPaquete.title: TrasladoPaquete

camino_slug.description: Route slug from plan_camino_itinerary; needed to price the luggage transfer by official stages.
camino_slug.title: Camino Slug

extras_ids.description: COMPLETE new list of suplemento_id values from camino_extras_catalog. Omit for the defaults (pilgrim credential + insurance by nationality).
extras_ids.title: Extras Ids

incluir_mochila.description: true to add luggage transfer between stages (one bag per traveller, priced by official stages covered).
incluir_mochila.title: Incluir Mochila

nacionalidad.description: Customer's nationality or country of residence, free text or ISO code (e.g. Spain, ES, German). Sets the included travel insurance; pass it or `residente_espana`.
nacionalidad.title: Nacionalidad

oferta_paquete_firmada.description: The latest `oferta_paquete_firmada` returned by quote_camino_package, swap_camino_hotel or update_camino_package_extras, passed verbatim.
oferta_paquete_firmada.title: Oferta Paquete Firmada

residente_espana.description: true if the travellers live in Spain, false otherwise; overrides `nacionalidad` when choosing the insurance.
residente_espana.title: Residente Espana

traslados.description: COMPLETE new list of private transfers from camino_transfer_options, each {origen_poblacion_id, destino_poblacion_id, fecha, categoria_id}. Omit or [] for none.
traslados.title: Traslados
